title: Compact IMACs with Reasonable Security
summary: The presented IMAC incurs fixed image-space overhead from a feature vector and MAC tag; reducing this overhead while preserving meaningful security remains open.

formal_statement.body: Construct a more compact image message authentication code ($\mathrm{IMAC}$) while retaining reasonable security.

scope.domain: Design of compact image message authentication codes in symmetric cryptography.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Constructing a more compact IMAC that still provides reasonable security.

citations.label: Format-Preserving Compression-Tolerating Authenticated Encryption for Images

progress.summary: The paper presents this as an explicit research problem motivated by the fixed image-space overhead of transmitting a CLIP feature vector with a conventional MAC tag. It asks whether more compact IMACs can retain reasonable security.
citation_labels: Alexandra Boldyreva et al., Format-Preserving Compression-Tolerating Authenticated Encryption for Images
